description: spa_refresh mirror can ship an embedded SPA with index.html but ZERO hashed assets: remove_stale_entries deletes before copies land, and two overlapping 'just up' runs race the shared dist dir. Evidence 2026-08-25: instance healthy + CLI green while every asset 404'd. Mitigations landed: just-up flock lock (tmp/just-up.lock) and post-deploy smoke (scripts/smoke.nu, fails just up on any red route incl. every index-referenced asset). Structural fix (atomic swap + post-condition) open in fabro-332e.
resolution: partial: lock + smoke guard deployed; atomic swap open in fabro-332e

content: Post-deploy smoke runs as part of 'just up' and aborts the pipeline on any red probe

name: spa-crash-safe-publish
description: Crash-safe SPA publish (fabro-332e, commit ba8e5277c): spa_refresh publishes via ordered phases — additive copies, index.html flip LAST (only file referencing hashed assets by name), stale removal after; per-file temp+rename atomic replace; verify_index_references guards mixed staging snapshots pre-publish AND post-publish; SpaRefreshLock (tmp/fabro-dev-spa.lock, pid + /proc stale-break) serializes refresh across processes. When touching this path: keep the ordering contract, never delete-then-copy into the embedded assets dir.
